title: Ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health
supports_claim: WHO identifies ethical risks in AI for health including patient safety algorithmic bias and unethical collection or use of health data.
limitations: This is governance guidance and not validation of NutriGuide or a measurement of its incident rate.

title: Is ChatGPT an Effective Tool for Providing Dietary Advice?
supports_claim: Expert review found ChatGPT dietary advice was less effective for complex overlapping conditions and could not replace professional consultation.
limitations: The study assessed ChatGPT 3.5 with hypothetical cases in November 2023 rather than this product or real user outcomes.

title: The credibility of dietary advice formulated by ChatGPT: Robo-diets for people with food allergies
supports_claim: This study evaluated safety and accuracy of 56 ChatGPT-created diets for hypothetical people with food allergies.
limitations: The abstract alone does not establish clinical outcomes or apply to every allergy and model version.

title: An eating disorders chatbot offered dieting advice raising fears about AI in health
supports_claim: NPR reported NEDA took Tessa offline after testers received diet culture and weight-management content that NEDA said could harm people with eating disorders.
limitations: This is reported evidence about one deployment and includes differing accounts of vendor-change governance; it is not a controlled causal study.

title: Regulatory framework on artificial intelligence
supports_claim: The European Commission provides the official EU AI Act regulatory framework and implementation context.
limitations: This overview does not by itself classify the product or replace legal advice and GDPR analysis.

title: Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15
supports_claim: Vietnam has an official Personal Data Protection Law source relevant to processing health-related personal data.
limitations: A legal professional must determine applicability effective dates and product-specific obligations.
